programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Kai y Ray combaten en la segunda ronda de las semifinales con Zeo y Gordo. Ray empata con Gordo, por lo que todo depende ahora del combate entre Zeo y Kai. El duelo entre lo dos es tan potente que el estadio empieza a romperse. Al final, Kai cae derrotado ante Zeo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Zeo ha conquistado a Dranzer y Tyson empieza a temerlo. Visita solo el Bey Stadium donde tendrá que enfrentarse a él en la final y Kai lo desafía a un combate para que deje de dudar de sí mismo y se concentre en la batalla con Zeo. Tyson comprende que con sus amigos a su lado no puede perder.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: En la final del Campeonato, Tyson se enfrenta a Gordo y vence. Zeo derrota a Max y el título tendrá que decidirse en un último combate entre Tyson y Zeo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson tiene que luchar con Zeo, pero en esa última batalla se descubre que Zeo no es humano, sino un robot creado por el doctor Zagart para reemplazar a su hijo, que murió en un trágido accidente. Según el doctor Zagart, si Zeo consigue capturar los cuatro Bit Beasts sagrados, el poder de éstos lo convertirá en un chico de verdad. Al final gana Tyson, quien convence a Zeo de que debe ser feliz con lo que es. Y Tyson es, una vez más, el campeón del mundo de BeyBlade.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Cuando una estrella cae de los cielos, un joven blader llamado Yuki la estaba esperando. Enseguida se pone en marcha para ir en busca de Gingka, pero no es tarea fácil, pues alguien ha atraído a Gingka a una isla para combatir contra su viejo rival Kyoya.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Yuki se enfrenta en combate a un oscuro personaje llamado Johannes, pero Gingka acude a su rescate. Yuki le cuenta al grupo la historia de una estrella que cayó recientemente y que ha escogido a algunos bladers para que sean bladers legendarios. Yuki también les desvela que si el fragmento estelar cae en las manos equivocadas, se podría utilizar con malos propósitos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos están a punto de comenzar su periplo para encontrar a los ocho bladers legendarios, pero al toparse con Johannes deben combatir contra él. Gingka parece tener todas las de perder, hasta que Kyoya se une al combate y consigue derrotar a Johannes. El grupo prosigue entonces su búsqueda.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Mientras Gingka y sus acompañantes trabar amistad con los lugareños, Benkei y Kyoya encuentran a Ryuga en la cima de un volcán, y Kyoya reta a Ryuga a un combate bey. Ryuga le dice que no debería combatir porque todavía no conoce a su bey. Éste, ofendido, provoca a Ryuga.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Después de la derrota de Kyoya ante Ryuga, Gingka le reta a un combate bey, pero Ryuga le también le vence a él sin dificultad alguna. Yuki a su vez le reta a un combate pero el L-Drago Destroyer de Ryuga ataca sin piedad a su bey, Mercury Anubius. Yuki se entera de que en realidad él también es un blader legendario, pero a pesar de sus recién adquiridos poderes Ryuga vuelve a vencer.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Cuando un volcán entra en erupción, Gingka, Yuki y Kyoya cambian el curso de la lava utilizando sus beys y salvan a la aldea. Al marcharse de la isla se llevan una gran sorpresa cuando Kenta les comunica que él seguirá su camino solo. El grupo está triste pero le desea a Kenta toda la suerte del mundo en su aventura.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Kenta viaja a una remota ciudad en el desierto donde compite contra Ryuga en un torneo pero pierde. Entonces sigue a Ryuga en una durísima caminata llena de peligros. Su intención es convencer a Ryuga de que preste su fuerza de blader legendario a Gingka y a los demás con el fin de enfrentarse al mal. Ryuga se niega, pero Kenta tampoco está dispuesto a abandonar y se empeña en quedarse.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Johannes irrumpe en el templo Beylin buscando a un supuesto blader legendario. Dashan le planta cara al intruso y le reta a un combate bey. Pero el combate acaba repentinamente cuando Johannes retira a su Beat Lynx y se encarama a un tejado porque, según él, es una pérdida de tiempo combatir contra un blader de segunda como Dashan. Entonces aparece Chaoxin y les informa de que ha visto a un extraordinario y poderoso blader en la ciudad que utiliza un bey de color carmesí.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: En el campeonato por equipos se disputa una serie de combates en los que Dashan y Chiyun salen victoriosos, al igual que Johannes y su nueva compañera Motti. Cuando Yuki y Gingka retan a Mei-Mei y a Chaoxin, Yuki sufre una crisis de confianza y está a punto de abandonar. Con el apoyo de sus amigos consigue recuperarla y Gingka y él ganan el encuentro.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: El torneo por equipos continúa con los cuatro equipos finalistas. El equipo de Dashan y Chiyun gana su combate en un abrir y cerrar de ojos, pero Kyoya y Benkei disputan un largo combate contra Motti y Johannes, aunque finalmente Kyoya consigue derrotar a Johannes y clasificarse. Dos misteriosos bladers, Aguma y Bao, también se han clasificado.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: En la segunda ronda del torneo por equipos, Gingka y Yuki se enfrentan a Dashan y a Chiyun en un stadium en lo alto de una montaña. Gingka y Yuki ganan gracias a una nueva jugada estrella de Gingka llamada tornado cósmico. A continuación combaten el Puño de Beylin contra Kyoya y Benkei. El combate acaba enseguida con la victoria del Puño de Beylin, pues Kyoya y los demás se habían concentrado en Bao cuando en realidad el blader legendario era su compañero, Aguma.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Ginka y Yuki se trasladan hasta un antiguo templo bey para combatir contra Bao y Aguma, del Puño de Beylin, en la final del torneo por equipos Toryumon. El equipo del puño de Beylin empieza con fuerza y pronto ponen en un aprieto a Gingka y a Yuki. Éste piensa con rapidez y desliza a su bey hasta el tornado que ha creado Aguma, consiguiendo volver las tornas.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Tras ganar el torneo por equipos, Bao y Aguma desaparecen en un helicóptero. Johannes les sigue el rastro hasta un lugar inhóspito y les habla sobre el fragmento estelar del bey de Aguma. Mientras tanto, muy lejos de ahí, en un torneo en el desierto, los bladers intentan alcanzar lo alto de una torre con la esperanza de encontrar un bey muy especial si ganan. Kenta y Tsubasa se enfrentan para ser los primeros en llegar a lo más alto, pero Tsubasa vence.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Aguma y Bao siguen a Johannes para encontrarse con Pluto, que quiere que el Puño de Beylin se una en su oscura caza del poder. Gingka y sus amigos viajan a Grecia, donde los reciben Sophie, Gales, Julian y Klaus. Viajan a un templo en el que al parecer había un bey legendario, pero alguien lo ha destruido y no hay rastro del bey. En América, Tsubasa se dispone a participar en el torneo del Destroyer Dome para encontrar bladers legendarios por su cuenta.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Masamune y sus amigos presencian una discusión entre los Garcia antes de que comience el encuentro en el Destroyer Dome, por lo que parece que la familia está enfrentada. Pero durante el combate comprueban que no es más que una triquiñuela de los hermanos para que sus oponentes bajaran la guardia. Sin embargo, Tsubasa, Zeo y Toby se recuperan y consiguen derrotar a los Garcia y a los demás contendientes, clasificándose para la ronda final del torneo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Masamune y su nuevo bey, Blitz Striker, combaten contra viejos conocidos y caras nuevas en el Destroyer Dome. Masamune y los demás pronto se dan cuenta de que un nuevo blader llamado Rompecabezas está dominando el combate con su bey Forbidden Ionis, que parece tener la capacidad de desaparecer.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: En la final de la batalla campal del Destroyer Dome, seis bladers se enfrentan en busca de la victoria. Los bladers Rey, Rompecabezas, Zeo, Toby, Tsubasa y Masamune combaten con todas sus fuerzas. Rompecabezas empieza dominando y vence a Zeo y a Toby, pero se lleva una sorpresa cuando su bey Ionis pierde contra el Variares de Rey. Después Tsubasa pierde contra Rey, quedando sólo en pie Masamune. Su combate es tan intenso que el

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos viajan a África en busca de un blader legendario que al parecer vive en un misterioso lugar llamado montaña de la Bruma. Guiados por Nile y Damoure ascienden la montaña y llegan a un laberinto construido en hace muchos siglos. Nile les guía por el laberinto pero Gingka activa una puerta trampa y cae en sus entrañas. Aquí se encuentra con un blader llamado Ryuto, que está buscando un fragmento estelar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Ryuto lleva a Gingka y a sus amigos al templo de la montaña de la Bruma en busca del fragmento estelar. Pero no saben que están siendo seguidos de cerca por Johannes y los bladers del Puño de Beylin, quienes también van en busca del fragmento. Gingka y sus amigos se separan cuando se produce un combate en un antiguo beystadium. Todos los combatientes son eliminados excepto Kyoya y Aguma. Finalmente, Kyoya vence a Aguma en

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y los demás alcanzan un templo que creen que alberga un fragmento estelar, pero no pueden abrir la puerta que bloquea la entrada. Finalmente, Yuki utiliza sus conocimientos de astronomía para descifrar el enigma y, gracias a su bey, consigue abrir la puerta. El grupo encuentra a un blader llamado Dynamis que afirma ser el guardián del templo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka combate contra Dynamis, el guardián del templo. Gingka parece haber elegido la estrategia equivocada, pero admite que se había entusiasmado demasiado con el hecho de ser un blader legendario y confiesa que debería haber estado más atento. Dynamis queda impresionado por su sinceridad y detiene el combate para contarles a Gingka y a los demás la milenaria historia de los fragmentos estelares.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Dynamis intenta explicarle a Johannes y a sus seguidores que, hagan lo que hagan, el cielo decidirá lo que habrá de suceder con la resurrección de Hades y de Nemesis, no ellos. Tras esto se disputa un combate en el que participan todos los bladers. Kyoya está obsesionado con derrotar a Aguma y Gingka y sus amigos tienen que intervenir para detener el combate. Kyoya está furioso con Gingka y se marcha, comunicándoles que a partir de ahora seguirá su propio camino.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos llegan a la isla Beyster, donde se han apuntado a un torneo que ha atraído a un gran número de grandes bladers. Según las normas del torneo, los competidores deben intentar llegar a la cima de la montaña enfrentándose a adversarios al azar en el camino. Los ganadores continúan y los derrotados se marchan a casa. En uno de los grandes combates, Rey derrota a Aguma, mientras que en otro, Masamune sale vencedor contra Bao.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Mientras continúa el campeonato de la isla Beyster, cada vez son más los bladers eliminados de la competición. Gingka alcanza a Kenta y se da cuenta de que será su próximo contrincante en el torneo. Mientras ellos combaten, Rey se topa con su próximo adversario, que resulta ser Ryuga. Ambos tienen beys de rotación inversa y su combate es muy intenso.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: El torneo de la isla Beyster continúa mientras un blader invisible derrota a un participante tras otro en una serie de emboscadas. Cuando vence a Zeo y a Toby, Masamune promete que se vengará en su nombre en la final. Y tiene su oportunidad cuando él y ese blader, un mercenario llamado Chris, se enfrentan en la final. Finalmente, Chris sale victorioso y sucede algo sorprendente: es él, y no Masamune, el siguiente blader legendario.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka le pide a Chris, el último blader legendario, que se una a él en su lucha contra el mal, pero Chris le responde que sólo se unirá al mejor postor. Esto y las burlas de Chris hacia Masamune enfurecen a Rey, que lo reta a un combate. Los bladers de ambos equipos se unen en un colosal combate. Ryuga aparece repentinamente y exige que Chris le entregue su bey y su poder.

programme.desc: What began with twenty-four of the world’s top featherweights is now down to the final four as they battle in a one-night tournament to crown the Last Featherweight Standing.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Over the course of a year, twelve of the best GLORY featherweights will compete opposite twelve of the best RISE featherweights in a series of knockout bouts until one fighter becomes the Last Featherweight Standing.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

With bows in hand and rutting elk all around us, nearly every day brought close encounters, intense calling sequences, and heart-pounding moments at full draw.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.desc: Tonya needs to make some quick cash for the holidays, and takes a job transporting cocaine. On the way to the drop-off, her car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. While walking to a gas station for help, she is stopped by a police officer, and arrested for several warrants. Now in jail, Tonya, gets her friend Monica to make the delivery. Monica must get the car fixed, avoid a thief looking to steal the product, and make the delivery by the deadline or both will face deadly consequences.

programme.title: Messy
programme.desc: After being sent away to prison for possessing a firearm, Meek Richardson returns home to the DMV to find out his associate Kevin, is killed. Meek seeks to find the truth about his friend’s death, and finds that his enemies are closer than it seems.

programme.title: Money Gang Lit
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.desc: An expectant couple heads to a remote cabin to have a natural childbirth, but comes under attack from a predatory midwife who will stop at nothing to snatch their unborn child from them.

programme.desc: The fates of Tamara, TJ, and even Marcus himself hang in the balance after the bloody kitchen shooting. Did anyone survive? Will Pastor Marcus's mysterious powers intervene? Meanwhile, Jessica, TJ's ex-wife, faces scrutiny for her past actions and the future of their children. With the threat of child protective services looming, the clock is ticking to find answers and rebuild shattered lives.

programme.title: Toxic Affair
programme.desc: A young woman abandoned by her mother and raised by her father has a miscarriage which derails her life. In an attempt to find support, she seeks out her married sister, only to find herself in a toxic affair.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Blake, a man on the verge of marriage who becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge orchestrated by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: Bloodline Secrets
programme.desc: Thirty-three-year-old Keisha is engaged to be married to the man of her dreams, Joseph. Joseph believes he’s ready for marriage with the love of his life but his best friend, John, has his doubts about Keisha’s faithfulness. When family secrets come out of the shadows, it puts their marriage and lives in jeopardy.

programme.title: Counteract
programme.desc: Amateur and immature social media influencer, Sylvia Shaw has set out to aide her struggling family from financial ruin. Doing so, she is lured into working for a mysterious company that promises fame and great wealth. But soon realizes, her new employer is a mystery, for many reasons.

programme.title: Only 48
programme.desc: When Tracy Harris is abducted and held for ransom, her father Keith has only 48 hours to deliver $500,000. Forced back into the criminal world he tried to escape; Keith faces dangerous alliances and hidden truths in order to save his daughter.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: The Honeymoon
programme.desc: On her birthday, Summer is publicly humiliated when her fiancé, Chance, and her best friend, Portia, reveal their affair. Ultimately, Summer must confront the consequences of her actions as she fights for her life and seeks justice.

programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. - Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.desc: In this instalment, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lifts the veil on the products people buy. Almost everything we buy has a direct impact on our environment. We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 4 - Nature’s Heroes: Bangladesh - Part 1
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - USA: The end of oil - Part 1
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll have to learn to do without oil within 20, 30 or 100 years. What will be the consequences? What are the solutions at stake? This new episode of Earth From Above attempts to answer these questions. From China to Benin, including Azerbaijan, Belgium and Canada, Earth From Above takes us on a new trip around the world, in search of black gold.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - A la carte grills
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Day 7 of the World Pickleball League brings a critical and dramatic game between Mumbai Pickle Power and the Bengaluru Jawans. programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The penultimate day of World Pickleball League Season 2 heats up at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden with a high-stakes rematch of last year's semifinals between the Hyderabad Superstars and the Bengaluru Jawans. The spotlight shines on a "mouthwatering" women's singles clash between two unbeaten titans, Shawn Mendes and Katerina Stewart, where one historic winning streak is destined to end. From tactical mixed doubles experiments to the high-pressure debut of Eduardo Irizarry, every point is a desperate fight to stay "in the hunt" for a final spot. With commentators on the "edge of their seats" witnessing unbelievable defensive plays and "blistering" side outs, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: The Twin Cities, Minneapolis and St. Paul, while distinct in character, share a deep appreciation for music and cultural diversity. Chunz and Makh set out to discover the sounds and messages of unity emerging in the African community with traditional performer Christian Adeti and dive into a new genre of Somali rap with rapper DJ Fawzi. With it’s vibrant modern culture and rich musical history, The Twin Cities are a special destination you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: Known as the quintessential party music, Polka is alive and evolving in the great city of Milwaukee. At the beloved festival of Germanfest, Polka Hall of Fame legend Peggy Mueller showcases her traditional roots while The November Criminals share their fusion of polka and hip-hop, making it clear there is something for everyone. From buttonboxes to beers and brats, this is a city full of personality and a deep love for its musical heritage.

programme.title: American Beats
programme.desc: Kansas City, Missouri, is an integral part of jazz history in America. Shaped by legends who once graced its streets, it is bursting with deep history, mouth-watering cuisine and a lively jazz scene. World-renowned trumpeter, tap dancer, and entertainer, Lonnie McFadden and celebrated singer and tap dancer Chloe McFadden, show Chunz and Makh what it’s all about. From finger-licking barbecue to sports events and a bustling nightlife, this city is a cultural hub offering endless opportunities for a fun-filled getaway.

programme.title: Cheat Meal

programme.title: Cheat Meal

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: For George Kourounis‚ ground zero for stormchasing is Oklahoma City, the capital of´Tornado Alley´.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: The Angry Planet team heads to Africa to climb the steep and very active Nyiragongo Volcano in the Congo that erupted in 2002, sending 125,000 people fleeing for their lives. Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the bubbling lake of molten lava and investigates the risk the dangerous volcano poses to both the people of city of Goma and the Mountain Gorillas who live on the nearby jungle slopes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson. This year they stormchase in Newfoundland, site of the hurricane that pulled Mark out of a life-threatening depression.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Some of the fiercest weather can be experienced at the area the South Americans call the “Fin del Mundo”.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to “Tornado Alley” with 3 fellow stormchasers to see what the 2007 Storm Season will bring.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George experiences the most extreme climates in North America. First he visits the hottest place on the continent – Death Valley, then the coldest – Snag, Yukon.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Geoorge explores Java at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: “Angry Planet” is there as 3 storms make landfall as hurricanes in the US.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size. In Crimea, a mountain has been carved into a james bondian submarine base. In northern Ukraine, the Chernobyl nuclear site has been reduced to a radioactive wasteland.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George returns to the “Fin Del Mundo” at the southern tip of Argentina, this time to sail on a Russian icebreaker to Antarctica. After braving the stormy Drake passage, he explores volcanic Deception Island, camps out in the Antarctic snow, and paddles a kayak through icebergs calved off the melting glaciers.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: BENDIGO Bendigo was one of the biggest gold finds in history. it’s literally built on rivers of gold. Her grand hotels and theatres have played host to international celebrities… and some shady characters too.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: NEWCASTLE Like it's English namesake, Australia’s Newcastle also has a reputation for toughness and heavy toil, but it’s also a town with a unique identity, a rich maritime history and more than its share of eccentric characters.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: BRISBANE In 1941 sleepy tropical Brisbane found itself the nerve centre for the Pacific War effort. The former convict colony found itself changing quickly, yet politically Queensland is the most conservative state in Australia.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: ST KILDA Once a seaside retreat for 19 Century yuppies, later a suburb defined by the heroin addicts who flocked there, St Kilda has endured a constant cycle of boom and bust – Today it is again one of Melbourne’s most desired addresses.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: ADELAIDE City of Churches it may be but Adelaide has always been a strange mix of progressive politics and small town parochialism. Adelaide has had its share of drama too.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
